required_fields.name: solver_version
required_fields.purpose: Records solver version for replay and dependency review.

required_fields.name: trajectory_id
required_fields.purpose: Binds all observables to one simulated trajectory or ensemble.

required_fields.name: cycles
required_fields.purpose: Correction-cycle count represented in the evidence.

required_fields.name: parity_history
required_fields.purpose: Cycle-indexed parity expectation or parity measurement proxy.

required_fields.name: logical_error_proxy
required_fields.purpose: Bit-flip and phase-flip proxy scores with confidence.

required_fields.name: wigner_metadata
required_fields.purpose: Compact phase-space metadata without storing heavy image arrays.

required_fields.name: confidence
required_fields.purpose: Confidence that the solver evidence supports the cascade classification.

hqa_mapping_rules.parity_history: maps to syndrome persistence and cycle pressure
hqa_mapping_rules.photon_loss_events: maps to seed error and jump-density pressure
hqa_mapping_rules.wigner_metadata: maps to phase-space stability notes only
hqa_mapping_rules.cascade_indicator: maps to LOW_ACTIVITY, WATCHLIST, or CASCADE_LIKE risk labels
hqa_mapping_rules.confidence: bounds the contribution of solver-derived evidence

rejection_rules: Reject evidence when parity_history length differs from cycles.
Reject attempts to request live hardware, pulse changes, or HAL execution.
Reject heavy binary/image arrays in the evidence packet; store metadata only.
boundary: Contract-only lane. It defines required solver evidence but does not run bosonic simulation, validate physical cat-qubit hardware, or grant live control authority.
